description: Compares two priced LLMs on six common task shapes (support answer, invoice extraction, lead scoring, email draft, translation, search re-ranking). Returns list prices, cost per 1,000 requests on each model, the cost ratio, the break-even (how often the new model's results must work first time, relative to the current one, to cost no more per result that works) and the current model's announced shutdown.

from.description: The current model: an LLM id from /models.json (openai/gpt-4o), an OpenRouter id or the model's name

to.description: The new model: an LLM id from /models.json (openai/gpt-6-luna), an OpenRouter id or the model's name

name: model_switch_cost

costChange.description: The change in cost per request across the tasks

priceChanged.description: Date this model's price last changed; null if unchanged since tracking began

priceChecked.description: Date this model's price was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

fromShutdown.description: The current model's announced API shutdown, if any

permalink.description: A page on this site that shows this result, for a person to open

switchTestUrl.description: The browser test that runs your own prompt on both models with your own API key

assumption.description: What goes in and comes out; illustrative sizes, not measurements

breakEven.description: How often the new model's results must work first time, relative to the current model's, to cost no more per result that works

costRatio.description: New cost divided by current cost per request

priceChanged.description: Date this model's price last changed; null if unchanged since tracking began

priceChecked.description: Date this model's price was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

tokenFactor.description: Tokens the new model counts for text that is 1 token on the current one, where the provider publishes it; otherwise 1

title: Model switch cost
